cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says a court case management system is in service in any court. The eJustice system described in 2018 is outside the window.
cells.note: In July 2025 the Chief Justice said the Supreme Court is entirely on paper and that work to extend e-justice to it is under way (NAM-001, NAM-002). The 2018 description of eJustice in the High Court (NAM-005) is outside the window, so stage 2.
